name: risk
description: For each decision, choose the option you prefer.
instructions: If this part is drawn for payment, one of the ten decisions is drawn at random and the option you chose in it is played for real money.

name: voucher
description: What is the most you would pay for a voucher worth $3.00?
instructions: You have $5.00 to spend. A price between $0.00 and $5.00 is drawn after the study. If your bid is at least the price, you buy the voucher and pay the price, not your bid; otherwise you keep the $5.00. Bidding what the voucher is worth to you is your best choice.
